scripts.check: vp check && node scripts/with-platform.ts local pnpm exec svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.cf:check: node scripts/with-platform.ts cloudflare svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.cron:sweep: node scripts/with-env.ts CODEVIEW_SKIP_SIDECAR=1 -- cargo run --release --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml -p codeview-cli -- cron sweep
scripts.cron:parse-one: node scripts/with-env.ts CODEVIEW_SKIP_SIDECAR=1 -- cargo run --release --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml -p codeview-cli -- cron parse-one
scripts.cron:catalog: node scripts/with-env.ts CODEVIEW_SKIP_SIDECAR=1 -- cargo run --release --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml -p codeview-cli -- cron catalog
scripts.cron:mimic: node scripts/with-env.ts CODEVIEW_SKIP_SIDECAR=1 -- cargo run --release --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml -p codeview-cli -- cron mimic
scripts.cron:seed-std: node scripts/with-env.ts STATIC_R2_TARGET=local WRANGLER_PERSIST_TO=.wrangler/state CODEVIEW_SKIP_SIDECAR=1 -- cargo run --release --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml -p codeview-cli -- cron seed-std
scripts.cron:seed-std:if-missing: node scripts/with-env.ts STATIC_R2_TARGET=local WRANGLER_PERSIST_TO=.wrangler/state CODEVIEW_SKIP_SIDECAR=1 -- cargo run --release --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml -p codeview-cli -- cron seed-std --if-missing
scripts.static:std: node scripts/with-env.ts STATIC_R2_TARGET=remote CODEVIEW_SKIP_SIDECAR=1 -- cargo run --release --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml -p codeview-cli -- cron seed-std
scripts.static:local: node scripts/with-env.ts STATIC_R2_TARGET=local WRANGLER_PERSIST_TO=.wrangler/state CODEVIEW_SKIP_SIDECAR=1 NAME?=serde VERSION?=1.0.228 -- cargo run --release --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml -p codeview-cli -- cron parse-one && node scripts/with-env.ts STATIC_R2_TARGET=local WRANGLER_PERSIST_TO=.wrangler/state CODEVIEW_SKIP_SIDECAR=1 -- cargo run --release --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml -p codeview-cli -- cron freshness-merge --run-id local-static --bootstrap --write-catalog
scripts.static:batch: node scripts/with-env.ts STATIC_R2_TARGET=local WRANGLER_PERSIST_TO=.wrangler/state CODEVIEW_SKIP_SIDECAR=1 -- cargo run --release --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml -p codeview-cli -- cron seed-std --if-missing && node scripts/with-env.ts STATIC_R2_TARGET=local WRANGLER_PERSIST_TO=.wrangler/state CODEVIEW_SKIP_SIDECAR=1 TOP_CRATE_COUNT?=30 -- cargo run --release --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml -p codeview-cli -- cron publish-run --corpus top:{TOP_CRATE_COUNT} --max-total {TOP_CRATE_COUNT}
